veranderings.na: lê, en hulle het oorvertel dat
veranderings.rede: Without its own subject and auxiliary, 'oorvertel' can be read as part of the clause 'waar Mapungubwe lê', as if Mapungubwe does the retelling; a separate main clause (with the AWS comma) removes the ambiguity.
